artifacts.synopsis: The SJC denied a complaint by Kirk Lyons challenging Western Carolina Presbytery's dismissal of charges he filed against TE Craig Bulkeley, finding no clear error in the presbytery's determination that grounds existed under BCO 31-8, 34-2, and 32-20 to decline the charges, though the SJC noted the presbytery erred (non-prejudicially) in denying Lyons standing, since filing BCO 32-2 charges brought him under the court's jurisdiction.
